about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Warren Davidson

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
statements.title: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
sentences: Mr. Chairman, I rise today in support of Chairman Hill's amendment to extend the Defense Production Act for an additional 5 years.
Mr. Chair, I urge all of our colleagues to support this amendment.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CENSORSHIP BY THE CHINESE COMMUNIST PARTY
statements.title: CENSORSHIP BY THE CHINESE COMMUNIST PARTY
sentences: Police prevented people from taking pictures and ordered witnesses to delete footage.

Because China's censorship apparatus links police surveillance with telecommunications networks, search engines, social media platforms, and state-controlled media, it allows the authorities to identify and suppress information that could embarrass the Chinese Communist Party or undermine their preferred narratives with frightening efficiency.
Now this dystopian system is even more efficient and powerful with modern technologies, smartphones, search engines, surveillance cameras, and government controlled platforms.
When Elon Musk bought Twitter, the Biden administration was working to build a Disinformation Governance Board to coordinate their rapidly expanding censorship operations.
Under the same guise of protecting kids used by the U.K., the USA just passed a digital ID bill under the guise of banning Central Bank Digital Currency.
The United States effectively set a go-live date for CBDC in 2030.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXTENSION OF AUTHORITIES OF TITLE VII OF THE FOREIGN INTELLIGENCE SURVEILLANCE ACT OF 1978

sentences: Central bank digital currency is communist money for the digital age.
Unfortunately, some of my Democrat colleagues, who are united in opposition to warrantless surveillance of all forms, somehow don't see the central bank digital currency for what it is.
Well, I will tell you: Anyone can find an excuse.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM UNAUTHORIZED HOSTILITIES IN THE ISLAMIC REPU
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM UNAUTHORIZED HOSTILITIES IN THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN
sentences: Make no mistake, Iran is an enemy of the United States.
For some, this debate will be about whether we should even be fighting in Iran.
That is not what the War Powers Act says.
I rise in support of this War Powers Resolution today because the moral hazard posed by a government no longer constrained by our Constitution is a grave threat.
Democratic President Harry Truman obstructed a vote on the Korean war, pretending it was, instead, a U.N. police action.
This dereliction of duty is commonly mocked as an example of constitutional avoidance, and it contributed to the passage of the War Powers Act.
President Trump's America First message was supposed to be a rejection of the globalist war machine whose endless wars have left America less free, less safe, and more burdened by debt.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GUIDING AND ESTABLISHING NATIONAL INNOVATION FOR U.S. STABLECOINS ACT
statements.title: GUIDING AND ESTABLISHING NATIONAL INNOVATION FOR U.S. STABLECOINS ACT
sentences: Regulating stablecoins is long overdue at the Federal level, but make no mistake, stablecoins aren't new.
The New York Department of Financial Services has regulated stablecoins in the State of New York since 2018.
My Republican colleagues are exactly right about the stablecoins and the need for regulation.
On the product, the GENIUS Act, we agree we have five amendments that we want to do to the GENIUS Act that we are doing in the CLARITY Act, and they are important.
Frankly, while the GENIUS Act does address retail CBDC, and it is an important concession because Democrats want a surveillance state Central Bank Digital Currency.
Republicans are thankfully united in opposing Central Bank Digital Currency, but we should deal with that fully here.

On March 8, 2023, in a dialogue with Chairman Hill, Federal Reserve Chairman Jerome Powell said that they would need congressional approval for a retail CBDC, but he went on to explain that you could have a layered CBDC.
I will talk about that later, but we also need to protect self-custody, which is the ability for you to move your money directly person to person without an intermediary.
We do in the CLARITY Act, and that is why I oppose the bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ANTI-CBDC SURVEILLANCE STATE ACT
statements.title: ANTI-CBDC SURVEILLANCE STATE ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, central bank digital currency poses an existential threat to western civilization.
That is what central bank digital currency is.
Central bank digital currency inserts government between you and your money.
Another word for central bank digital currency is programmable money.
That is why cryptocurrency was invented, frankly.
Mr. Speaker, I urge all our colleagues to vote for Mr. Emmer's bill and stop this threat to our way of life.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CENTRAL BANK DIGITAL CURRENCY
statements.title: CENTRAL BANK DIGITAL CURRENCY
sentences: A lot of people don't necessarily know what a central bank digital currency is, so we will start with a definition.
A central bank digital currency begins with the central bank.
The Federal Reserve manages our currency.
Currency is a means of payment.
In a central bank digital currency, they would be able to know with a digital identity who you are because they have got a digital ID.

They have tied it with your facial recognition features, your geolocation data, all your transaction data that they can discern and everything else they can find about you in a government database in China, and they build what is known as a social credit score.
They are linking this digital ID with the payment system, the digital currency, and in that sense, they are kind of essential components to the way that it works.
Here in the central bank digital currency, digital ID is a critical component to how it works.
The reality is that 100-plus countries around the world are developing a central bank digital currency.
They are developing essentially the same kind of central bank digital currency that China is.
Literally, multiple components of the Federal Reserve are actively recruiting people to write code to develop a central bank digital currency.
The central bank digital currency is kind of the equivalent.
We would need permission from the legislature before we could establish a central bank digital currency.
I met with them, and they are developing a central bank digital currency.
They, too, are designing, developing, and testing how a central bank digital currency could work.
That is what a central bank digital currency is.
People often associate every kind of digital money with central bank digital currency.
Bitcoin may be the most widely known form of crypto, certainly the biggest share of the market value.
If you look at the Bitcoin white paper--you can look it up out there.
This is why Bitcoin became popular.
With blockchain, that is the way it is done.
Once you create a central bank digital currency, you have empowered the central bank to see every side of every transaction.

Climate change alarmists--climatologists, as I refer to them--could program the money so that if you are driving a hybrid vehicle but still need to buy gas from time to time to keep your hybrid internal combustion engine running, you could pay $2 a gallon for gas.
That is why central bank digital currency is truly a threat to Western civilization.
If we look at the Bitcoin White Paper and many of the other use cases, Crypto is designed to somewhat separate money from the State.
Actively, right now, the Federal Reserve is hiring coders to write code and develop a central bank digital currency.
Actively, right now, just as the gentleman from Arizona (Mr. Schweikert) who spoke right before me addressed, the United States has a massive debt problem.
The last time the planet had this much debt was at the end of World War II.
Our debt-to-GDP ratio, the amount of money we owe versus the size of our economy, is about the same size as it is right now.
The money system they have in mind is the central bank digital currency.
We could launch this central bank digital currency.
When he came into office, Donald Trump's executive order, among digital assets, banned central bank digital currency.
That is why my colleague from Minnesota (Mr. Emmer) has moved a bill to ban central bank digital currency.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, America's resources should always serve America's interests, and 22 rescissions to wasteful foreign aid and biased media totaling $9.4 billion is a good start.
I commend this legislation because as the national debt climbs toward $37 trillion, U.S. taxpayers deserve a government that serves them, not radical policies abroad or at home.
I commend the $1 billion rescission to the Corporation for Public Broadcasting.
Additionally, international institutions have abandoned their original missions to promote development in exchange for radical gender ideological and climate priorities.
That is why I support the rescissions package, and I urge support for the bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CHINESE CURRENCY ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2025
statements.title: CHINESE CURRENCY ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to urge this body to support H.R. 386, the Chinese Currency Accountability Act of 2025.

Mr. Speaker, this critical bill ensures that the United States stands firm against increasing the weight of the Chinese renminbi in the International Monetary Fund's Special Drawing Rights, their currency basket, unless China changes course.
Most notably, this currency basket influences the IMF lending rate.
In 2016, the IMF decided they were going to include a nonmarket-based currency, the Chinese renminbi.
More concerning, in 2022, as Chairman Hill pointed out, the IMF actually increased the weight to 12.8 percent, making it the third most prominent currency, even though China lacks independence.

This bill directs the U.S. Secretary of the Treasury to oppose any further increase in the renminbi's weight unless China complies with its IMF obligations, that it is found to not be a currency manipulator, and that it adheres to the Paris Club and OECD rules on export credits.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill.
